version: LOCK 40 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - Safira, the caravanserai: the slow pilgrim and lost at night
builds_on: LOCK 34 runner, LOCK 36 roads (Gate of Patience opens after chapter 1). Design references (not shown): Quran 2:153, 16:16.

safira.name: Safira
safira.text: A great square courtyard of mud brick where the northern caravans rest. Camels kneel in rows and traders sleep on the roof under the stars.

safira.title: The caravanserai masjid
safira.text: A small prayer hall off the courtyard, its mihrab pointing past the camel lines.
safira.first: A camel driver from the far south prays beside you and smiles. “Every road ends facing the same way.”

people.name: Harun

lines.wary: Harun checks a camel's hoof and ignores you.
lines.friendly: “The north road is long. A caravan moves at the speed of its slowest camel - and its slowest man.”
lines.warm: “Ride with me next season. I could use someone people trust.”

memory: “You walked four hours behind my caravan with an old man. I've thought about that.”

people.name: Amina

lines.wary: “Two coins for the roof, three for a room. Water is free.”
lines.friendly: “Every traveller in the world sleeps here once. Most of them snore.”
lines.warm: “Your room is ready before you ask. Sit, eat.”

memory: Amina holds your face like she held her grandson's. “You brought him back by the star.”

lines.wary: Old Shuayb sits on his bundle. “Hajj is done. Home is still far.”
lines.friendly: “I saw the Ka'bah, child. Seventy years I waited.”
lines.warm: “When I reach my son, I'll tell him a stranger from Ilmara carried me.”

a.text: Harun's caravan leaves for Wadira this morning. Old Shuayb, going home from Hajj, walks slowly with a stick. “He holds us back half a day each day,” Harun says. “I'm leaving him. Someone else will take him.” Shuayb sits on his bundle and says nothing.

choices.label: Walk with Shuayb behind the caravan
Pay for a camel for him · 15 coins

walk.text: You walk at Shuayb's pace. It takes four hours to cover what the caravan did in two. He tells you about Makkah the whole way - and at the end, about the son he hasn't seen in twenty years.

camel.text: Harun grumbles but rents you a camel. Shuayb rides out of the gate like a king and waves until he is out of sight.

left.text: The caravan leaves. At noon Shuayb is still sitting on his bundle in the courtyard.

walked: Walked an old pilgrim home at his pace
camel: Paid a camel for old Shuayb

missions.title: Lost at night
missions.button: Amina's grandson is lost in the dunes

a.text: Amina's grandson went after a strayed goat at sunset and hasn't come back. It is dark, and the dunes all look the same.

b.text: Out in the dunes the lantern shows only sand. Then you remember what Harun said at supper: find the one star that never moves, low in the north, and keep it on your right to walk back east.

found.text: With the star on your right you find the boy asleep against the goat in a hollow, and you walk him home by the same star. Amina doesn't say anything. She just holds his face in her hands.

lost.text: You walk in circles until near midnight, when you hear camel bells - the boy found his own way back by following them. Harun's men find you.

wait.text: Harun's men go out with torches and bring the boy back near midnight.

found: Found Amina's grandson by the stars
